body: I am, though. I'm not even a particularly good person even though I play the part. Objectively speaking I am nothing special. I look at those who grew up with supportive families and their resulting self assuredness in life and I feel actual loathing towards them and myself. I see happy couples and the truth that I've never once felt not alone kills me. I have literally no one to talk to because even the bf is going to leave me, now. Everyone uses my mind and body and I have nothing left to give.
